hero.eyebrow: From the fertile lands of the Nile Delta to the finest tables around the world.
hero.titleA: A journey that begins in land we inherited with pride,
hero.titleB: and ends on your customers’ tables.
hero.storyP1: Generations of our family have farmed the Nile Delta — learning the silt, the water and the turn of the season from the people who worked it before them. The land came to us as a responsibility rather than a business, and we keep it with what this generation was given: tested soil, measured irrigation, controlled curing rooms.
hero.storyP2: What we grow, we see through. Harvest, sorting, packing, cold storage, export — one journey, managed by us, so the crop never changes hands without someone here answering for it. And every sweet potato we set aside is chosen against a single question: will it still be right when it reaches your customer?
hero.quote: Nothing leaves our hands that we would not put on our own table.

steps.name: Wash & sort
steps.desc: Washed, then sorted for shape, skin finish and internal defects.

steps.name: Grading & calibre

steps.name: Packing & labelling

steps.name: Pre-loading

trust.title: Four ways a produce import goes wrong
trust.sub: And what we have in place so it doesn’t happen to your container.

items.risk: Arrival quality doesn’t match the sample you approved.
items.fix: Pre-shipment inspection with dated photos of the actual lot, sent before the container leaves.

items.risk: Certificates that can’t be checked — or belong to someone else.
items.fix: Scheme number, validity and certifying body for every credential, so you can verify them at source.

items.risk: A gap in the cold chain that nobody can account for.
items.fix: A data-logger in every reefer; the full temperature trace is handed over on arrival.
One named contact who replies within four hours, Sunday to Friday.

items.q: Can we audit your farm and packhouse?
items.a: Yes — in person or by video call, whenever suits you. We will also host a third-party audit at your request. [[confirm]]

items.q: Which certifications do you actually hold?
items.a: The schemes listed above, and only those. Numbers and validity dates are published here once the certifying body has confirmed them.
Every carton carries a lot code that maps back to the field, the harvest date and the packing shift. We can trace forward or back within four hours.

items.q: Do you test for pesticide residues?
items.a: Yes — against EU maximum residue limits under Regulation 396/2005, with a residue report available per shipment. [[confirm]]

items.q: What happens if a load arrives out of spec?
items.a: Send photos and the logger file within 24 hours of discharge. We assess the claim against our own pre-shipment record and settle it on the next shipment or by credit note. [[confirm]]

cta.title: Certifications check out?
